name: smwgraphics-doremi-fantasy-milon-no-dokidoki-daibouken-guardian-s-lair-world
title: DoReMi Fantasy: Milon no DokiDoki Daibouken - Guardian's Lair (World 2)
description:
The 2nd dungeon's tasty BG and FG from DoReMi Fantasy, you can use this for a sweets-themed stage (obviously), or you could just use the starry night sky BG for something else (even if I don't know how to animate palettes yet, since in the original game the BG palette was animated). I had to compress 4 of the original game's palettes used for this FG tileset into 1, including the fact that I had to paint the moving ledge platform red.
For better performance with the ledge hole sprite, use this patch.
